integrity: The structural central-parameter theorem and binary exception are credited to Rowen–Segev (2016). The exact constrained finite-field count is the assessed contribution. No independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only two-by-two matrices and nondegenerate rank-one idempotent pairs have a subfield-ring classification; degenerate-pair subring types and larger matrix sizes are not covered. Exact counting is proved; the finite checker is supplementary. Potential unindexed prior enumerations remain.
title: Frobenius-degree and orbit laws for pairs of idempotents in finite matrix rings
